hero.title: Become a teacher on Linglify
hero.subtitle: Create language courses, automate routine tasks, and earn money — the platform only takes a 25% commission.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.description: Choose the “Teacher” role during registration and get a 30-day free trial.

steps.title: Create a course
steps.description: Add different lesson types, upload materials, and submit the course for moderation.

steps.title: Start earning
steps.description: After publication, students enroll and pay for the course. 75% of the amount is yours.

features.builderDesc: Video, tests, interactive tasks, dialogues, lexical trainers — all in one place.
features.analyticsDesc: Track engagement, progress, and weak topics for each student.
features.chatDesc: Answer questions right inside the platform and receive system notifications.
features.certsDesc: The platform issues verifiable certificates automatically — without your manual work.

pricing.footer: Start with a 30-day free trial — no card required. Payments in Belarusian rubles.
